name: Advanced Fabric Manufacturing Technologies
description: Advanced fabric manufacturing technologies; yarn preparation for high-speed weaving, advances in winding and warping, sizing materials and related chemistry, rheology of size paste, sizing machine configurations, sizing of filament yarns; shuttleless weaving systems, advancements with respect to productivity, yarn characteristics and resource requirement, air-jet, rapier and water-jet weaving systems, specialty weaving; 3D weaving, multiphase weaving; weft and warp knitting, warp knitted structures with multiple guide bars, spacer fabrics, whole garment knitting; braiding, biaxial and triaxial braids, 3D braiding; nonwoven technologies, advances in web formation and bonding technologies, 3D nonwovens.
